notes:
This version is required: Meki Cloud sync asks older Macs to update.

New
- Edit, Meki’s own editing view: Light, Color, Curve, Detail, Effects, Optics, Geometry with Upright, Defringe and Point colour, with History, Versions and Copy, Paste and Sync
- Presets and profiles in Edit: your Lightroom presets, New preset…, a profile browser with favourites, and the Meki and Meki Monochrome profiles
- Edits made in Meki show in the grid, in outputs and on Meki Cloud, are written to the photo’s sidecar, and Generate final makes a final from them
- Scripts: run your own Python scripts on photos from a scripts folder, with permissions you allow, dry runs, Undo run…, triggers and logs
- Outputs is a plan: a list and a calendar of what is due, a Plan sheet, and Release, Back to draft and Publish now; nothing publishes until you release it from Draft
- A gallery link can go live at a time you set in its share panel
- Projects sit in folders that nest, ordered by hand or by start date, with a Clients tab, client Merge and Delete, and Delete all contents for a folder
- One Location field for photos, projects, clients and New project, searching Apple Maps, with Open in Maps
- Statuses have icons and colours you choose in Settings › Customise › Statuses, and colour labels can be renamed in Settings › Customise › Labels
- One searchable Add filter menu in every filter bar and rule editor, with Copy on, Copies and Only copy filters
- Settings › Galleries chooses whether full-size downloads keep or strip metadata

Improved
- An import comes first: Meki’s background work and Meki Cloud wait behind a card import, saying “Waiting — importing first”, with Start now
- A task that keeps getting its turn stays running with “Taking turns with other tasks” instead of flipping between waits
- A Meki Cloud copy is released only against a copy Meki has read whole and checked, backup drives included
- Lossless finals from Meki are JPEG XL and carry the original’s metadata
- Meki stops with an update notice when Meki Cloud is older than this Meki needs

Fixed
- Library sync stops while this Mac’s clock is out of step with Meki Cloud
- A drive that is removed and added again is taken back on every Mac, and a removal Meki Cloud hasn’t answered waits for a connection
- Files go to a drive’s Trash all or nothing, and a drive pulled mid-way never makes a file read as gone
- Meki Cloud usage is counted once per library at a time
- Smaller fixes across Edit, scripts, storage, outputs and the sidebar
